{{Quote|We've been bad boys. We told them it was an ancient Mandalorian temple that held great magical power for us simple folk.|Jarkyc on his joke on the Imperial garrison [[Unidentified Imperial commander (Mandalore)|commander]]|<ref name="IC 501st" />}}
'''Jarkyc''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] who resided in the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]]. He wore a deep brown armor and his knuckles were tattooed with [[Mando'a/Legends|Mando'a]] runes.<ref name="IC 501st" />

Shortly after the formation of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] when an Imperial garrison was established on Mandalore, Jarkyc and his companion [[Hayar]] managed to convince the Imperial garrison [[Unidentified Imperial commander (Mandalore)|commander]] that a [[City of Bone|failed theme park]], built by Hayar's [[Hayar's brother|brother]], was a sacred Mandalorian temple. Intending to inspire awe among the local populace, the theme park was bought by the Empire which was used as their garrison base. Jarkyc then related the whole story as a joke on the [[Oyu'baat]], where former [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Bardan Jusik]] and [[Null-class Advanced Recon Commando|Null ARC]] [[Ordo Skirata]] listened to the story.<ref name="IC 501st" />
